corrections: Individually traced four-seat bubble shell, wraparound glazing, tall tapered mast fairing, two-blade rotor, narrow rising boom, fin and tail guard.
Later eight-hole instrument arrangement and annunciators from the manufacturer drawing, compact sloping engine/radio pedestal, shared T-bar cyclic, collectives, pedals and four upholstered seats.
Overlay iteration corrected painted side-wrap obstruction, square mast silhouette and excess panel brow height.
limitations: Panel overlay rectifies an oblique manufacturer diagram using equal gauge pitch; 0.105 m pitch, panel depth and absolute cockpit placement remain estimates.
Photograph corroborates cabin construction and controls but depicts a different instrument fit. Model follows the later handbook instrument arrangement, with simplified engine instruments and radios.
Manufacturer three-views have small scale differences; side dimensions take precedence for height. Static rotor azimuth differs, and the rear engine fairing and bubble remain visibly faceted.
Original geometry and markings only; reference pixels are not distributed.

controlReview.checks: Imported GLB control-point movement tested at positive and negative commands; all 20 aircraft pass. Cockpit pairs and all ten airplane exterior pairs visually inspected. Roll, pitch, rudder and declared pedal directions corrected; ailerons and full flap deployment corrected.
limitations: Checks cover existing bindings; Cherokee and Caravan pedal geometry is static.
Full control travel and flight response remain approximations unless independently dimensioned in the model reference notes.
This audit verifies movement; it does not upgrade legacy helicopter avionics or remove previously documented geometry limitations.
